text_block_list.text:
One day, Фудзи Кисэки is doing some magic
tricks
for a younger student.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And when I cast a little spell on this
coin...
Ta-dah!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's really gone! How'd you do
that?
text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
By using my magic, of course. Now, if I
do this...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Whoops... Apologies. It seems I've run
out of
magic for today.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'll astound you with even more dazzling
tricks
next time, so look forward to it. ♪
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Sigh... How could I have fumbled that? She must've been so disappointed...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки's sleight of hand isn't quite up
to snuff,
and she grows despondent over
failing to wow the
younger student.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
